features.title: Wait for detached process groups without probing every 15 ms
features.summary: Owned fork of the native local subprocess service: the group-exit poll backs off from 15 ms to 500 ms, so a job an agent detaches no longer costs the Host seconds of CPU while a short-lived tree is still seen at once.
failureModes: A process group that outlives its leader is still awaited until empty, only probed less often.
Every other behaviour is the pinned upstream code; drift is checked with scripts/native-fork-diff.mjs.

verification.testName: runs a command and reports its output
waits for a backgrounded child without probing its group every 15 ms

verification.reason: The fork replaces the Host subprocess service and renders no UI; every shell journey in the e2e suite runs through it, and the poll backoff is measured in tests/group-exit-poll.test.ts.
